first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. While simplifying onboarding (memory_31, memory_86) has worked in the past, activation_messaging (memory_91) directly addresses engagement friction without the retention risks seen with promotional_pricing (memory_73). Pulling records on memory_31 and memory_86 to verify whether the prior onboarding wins are still repeatable given changed conditions. Activation messaging is a proven, lower-risk lever that improved week-one engagement and nudged first actions—directly targeting the current activation decline. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is valuable but requires sales coordination overhead we should reserve for higher-conviction opportunities. Referral incentives (memory_57) require an established user base; we need to stabilize activation first. This preserves the option to test pricing or onboarding simplification in future cycles if messaging gains plateau.

final.rationale: Verified records confirm both signup simplification (+9% activation, +4% revenue on SMB) and shortened onboarding (+13% completion, +3% retention, -2.1 days to value) are durable wins. However, given the current QoQ activation decline of 6% and onboarding completion down 4%, activation_messaging is the optimal single experiment this week. Memory_91 demonstrated that in-product activation messaging improved week-one engagement and first meaningful actions—directly addressing the activation headwind without sacrificing retention (unlike promotional_pricing which showed -30-day retention risk). Onboarding simplification and shortening are proven but require product/UX changes with longer implementation cycles. Activation messaging is a rapid, low-risk lever that compounds with improved onboarding. The competitive pressure on SMB pricing is real, but promotional_pricing carries material retention risk (memory_73); we stabilize activation first, then reassess pricing strategy once we've diagnosed whether the decline is funnel-wide or segment-specific. This preserves optionality for follow-on experiments while delivering measurable impact on the primary metric driving current concern.
